blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors have submitted their formal offer of evidence to the Senate impeachment court in the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, prosecution adviser Robert Ace Barbers said on Wednesday. Barbers said the prosecutorial panel submitted its evidence on Tuesday evening, providing the Senate with bank, tax and corporate records. The team also filed net worth disclosure filings to support the prosecution’s case that Duterte allegedly amassed unexplained wealth and reportedly failed to truthfully disclose her net worth.
